title: Jewel Toned Glassy Brazilian Chicken Wrap
description: A kosher-friendly Brazilian dish featuring chicken, mustard, and a glassy jelly sauce, all wrapped in a lotus leaf wrap. This meal-prep friendly recipe is perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and blanch the chicken breast for 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the water and let it cool.
In a small bowl, mix together the mustard, jelly sauce, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Slice the cooled chicken into thin strips.
Lay a lotus leaf wrap flat and arrange the chicken strips down the center of the wrap.
Spoon the mustard and jelly sauce mixture over the chicken.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Serve the wraps warm or at room temperature.
